Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for taking the time last week. Per our contract (SOW v1 attached), AcmeCloud is on the annual prepay plan for USD 1.2M, and you asked for a staged release schedule tied to product milestones. Below is our proposed approach for invoicing and bank ops to make collections and VAT handling straightforward for both sides: 

Proposed staged release (high-level):
- Tranche 1: 40% on signature (invoice today) — USD 480,000
- Tranche 2: 30% after Milestone A (prod integration) — invoice on milestone completion
- Tranche 3: 30% after Milestone B (go-live) — final invoice and closeout

Invoicing & VAT notes:
- Redwood will issue invoices from our EU billing entity (Redwood Ireland) with VAT details. If AcmeCloud requires reverse-charge or a local VAT treatment, please confirm the billing entity for your EU VAT team.
- We can provide a country-by-country VAT breakdown on each tranche (see attached invoice matrix).

Banking / payment ops (to minimize failed wires):
- Preferred: wire to Oak Bank (SWIFT: OAKBIE2L), account: Redwood Inference Europe Ltd — details in the matrix.
- Alternate: ACH (US customers) — we will provide if needed.
- We will include an invoice reference code on each wire (ACME-PREPAY-2027-07) — please ask your AP to include this exactly.

Next steps I propose:
1) Olivia — confirm AcmeCloud's preferred legal entity for invoicing (and whether you need invoices in EUR or USD).
2) Finance (Markus/Neha) — confirm the banking stub and VAT breakdown in the attached workbook for tranche 1.
3) Once confirmed, we will send the signed SOW and tranche-1 invoice for immediate wire.

Attachments: 2027-06-prepay-invoice-matrix.xlsx, signed-sow-acme-v1.pdf

Thanks —
